content: आचारः [आचार-भावे घञ्] .²1 Conduct, behaviour, manner of action or of conducting oneself; सदाचारः good conduct; नीच˚ <ab>&c.</ab>; लोकाचारविवर्जिताः <ls>Pt. 5. 40</ls> ignorant of the ways of the world. .²2 Good conduct or behaviour; न शौचं नापि चाचारो न सत्यं तेषु विद्यते <ls>Bg. 16. 7</ls>; <ls>Ms. 1. 109</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">5. 4</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">3. 165</ls>. .²3 A custom, usage, practice; तस्मिन्देशे य आचारः पारंपर्यकमागतः <ls>Ms. 2. 18</ls>; <ls>Y. 1. 343</ls>. .²4 An established usage, fixed rule of conduct in life, customary law, institute or precept (<ab>opp.</ab> व्यवहार in law); आचार्य आचाराणाम् <ls>K. 56</ls>; <ls>Ms. 1. 109</ls>; <ab>oft.</ab> as the first member of <ab>comp.</ab> in the sense of ‘customary’, ‘usual’, ‘as is the custom’, ‘according to form’, ‘as a formality’; ˚पुष्पग्रहणार्थम् <ls>M. 4</ls>; see ˚धूम, ˚लाज below; परिकर्मन् <ls>Ś. 2</ls>. .²5 .³({%a%}) Any customary observance or duty; ˚प्रयतः <ls>V. 3. 2</ls>; गृहाचारव्यपदेशेन <ls>U. 3</ls>. .³({%b%}) A form, formality; आचार इत्यवहितेन मया गृहीता <ls>Ś. 5. 3</ls>; <ls>Mv. 3. 26</ls>. .³({%c%}) The customary salutation or bow, usual formality; आचारं प्रतिपद्यस्व <ls>Ś. 4</ls>; <ls>V. 2</ls>; अविषयस्तावदाचारस्य <ls>Mv. 2</ls>. .²6 Diet. .²7 A rule (of conduct).
